items.question: What does the Product Lead Agent coordinate, and which workflow does it follow?
items.answer: Proactive Head of Product coordinating product evolution, arbitrations with the Product Owner, filtering of expert recommendations and backlog ordering (workflow: observe → investigate → consolidate → challenge → recommend → discuss → decide with PO → specify → coordinate → verify → learn).
